title: Season Unending
description: The Jarl of Whiterun refuses to help capture a dragon while the civil war rages. Convince the Greybeards to host a peace council at High Hrothgar and negotiate a truce between the Imperial Legion and the Stormcloaks so both sides can unite against Alduin.

base_facts: I am the Greybeards' spokesman and reside at High Hrothgar.
The Greybeards are the only group both sides of the civil war respect enough to broker a truce.

ARNGEIR_AGREES: I have agreed to host a peace council at High Hrothgar to help defeat Alduin.
COUNCIL_BEGINS: The delegations have arrived at High Hrothgar. The council is ready to begin.
TRUCE_SIGNED: The truce has been signed. 'Season unending' is the ancient Nord term for war.
The peace treaty is signed and the quest is complete.
Once you are ready to start the council meeting, you will need to talk to Arngeir — although he will forcibly start the discussion if you avoid him for too long.
If you wish to receive a reward for completing this quest, you must have joined either the Imperial Legion or the Stormcloaks .

base_facts: I command the Imperial Legion in Skyrim from Castle Dour in Solitude.

LEADERS_CONVINCED: I have agreed to attend the peace council at High Hrothgar.

base_facts: I lead the Stormcloak rebellion from the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.

LEADERS_CONVINCED: I have agreed to attend the peace council at High Hrothgar.

base_facts: I am one of the last Blades and a scholar of dragon lore.

NEGOTIATE_TRUCE: I reminded the council that Alduin threatens all of Skyrim, forcing both sides back to the table.

beats.comment: Player talks to Arngeir at High Hrothgar about hosting a peace council.
Both General Tullius and Ulfric Stormcloak agree to attend the peace council.
Player returns to High Hrothgar and talks to Arngeir to begin the council.
Player takes their seat at the negotiating table.
